support.reason: ESP32-P4 Core-family controller; Wi-Fi through an ESP32-C6 module

display.note: 5-inch IPS; backlight on G22, reset through PI4IOE5V6408 E1 P4

touch.note: reset through PI4IOE5V6408 E1 P5, interrupt on G23

magnetometer.note: none listed; the BMI270 is a six-axis part

pmic.note: no PMIC: an IP2326 charger, an MP4560 buck-boost and an INA226 monitor, with the power rails switched through the PI4IOE5V6408 expanders

audio.amp: NS4150B (1 W, enabled through PI4IOE5V6408 E1 P1)

usb_bridge.note: on the USB-C port, USB1 in M5's pin map overview; the USB-A port is a host port

battery.note: removable NP-F550, 7.4 V; comes with the Tab5 Kit (K145), not with the Tab5 (C145)

dimensions.note: the Tab5 Kit with its battery is 26.7 mm deep and weighs 217.3 g

extra_components.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6, Thread and Zigbee for the ESP32-P4, which has no radio; SDIO on G8 to G13, reset on G15, power through PI4IOE5V6408 E2 P0; built-in antenna or MMCX, selected by E1 P0
control on the internal I2C bus; M5 gives no address
no I2C; controlled through PI4IOE5V6408 E2 P5 to P7
switchable 120 ohm terminator; port supply 6 to 24 V

errata.text: Shut the Tab5 down before cutting its power or changing the battery. After a direct power cut, wait 5 seconds before powering on again, or the IMU may fail to initialize.

The Tab5 charges only while it is powered on and initialized, not while off. A battery discharged below 6 V goes into protection: remove it, reset the device, refit it, and charge over USB-C; it trickle-charges for several minutes first.

PlatformIO's own platform-espressif32 has no Tab5 or ESP32-P4 board (none at v7.0.1). M5's PlatformIO example uses the pioarduino fork instead: platform = https://github.com/pioarduino/platform-espressif32.git#54.03.21, board = esp32-p4-evboard, board_build.mcu = esp32p4, board_build.flash_mode = qio, framework = arduino, the build flags -DBOARD_HAS_PSRAM, -DARDUINO_USB_CDC_ON_BOOT=1 and -DARDUINO_USB_MODE=1, and M5Unified and M5GFX from GitHub (its debug level and upload speed are left out here).

errata.text: From 2025.10.14 the ILI9881C display driver and GT911 touch driver were replaced by one integrated display and touch driver (ST7123, then ST7121 from 2026.4.28). Firmware built for the earlier parts may not run: rebuild it with current M5Unified and M5GFX.

On ST7123 and ST7121 units the LCD reset line (PI4IOE5V6408 E1 P4) must be push-pull or open-drain while driven low and input pull-up while high, or I2C communication becomes unstable. M5Unified 0.2.23 and M5GFX 0.2.30 or later do this during initialization.
